theme_strategy: Light mode by default for heavy data-entry readability, but support dark mode via tailwind 'dark' class. Tone is 'Swiss Brutalist / The Technical Look'. No soft shadows, highly structured.

headings.instruction: Use Work Sans for all headings (H1 to H4). Apply tracking-tight for sizes 2xl and above. Font weight 600 or 700. Never use Inter or Roboto.

body.instruction: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, tables, and numeric data. Highly legible for dense numbers.

colors.instructions: Strip out generic colors. Keep the UI mostly monochrome (whites, grays, charcoals). Use color *only* to indicate KPI status (Green=Achieved, Red=Failed) or primary actions (Blue). Do NOT use teal green (#1B93A4) or purple (#7351B7).

layouts.global: Sidebar navigation (w-64) + Main content area. Full viewport height.
layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4.
layouts.spacing: Dense inner padding for cards (p-4 or p-6). No massive white spaces as this is an enterprise data tool. Everything must fit efficiently.

surfaces_and_borders.style: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-border), NO box-shadows. Sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-md max).
surfaces_and_borders.cards: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-none or rounded-sm. No drop shadows. Hover states should slightly dim the border or background.

components.tables: Data dense. py-2 px-3 for cells. Header rows must have a subtle background (bg-gray-50) and uppercase text (text-xs text-gray-500 tracking-wider).
components.forms: Inputs use flat borders (border-gray-300). focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary. Shadcn-based but remove soft shadows.
components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm. Primary buttons are solid brand color. Secondary are outline with high contrast text.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Minimal grid lines (stroke-dasharray), no background fills unless necessary. Clear legends.

motion.rules: Minimalist. Use micro-interactions. Hover states on table rows (hover:bg-gray-50). Simple fade-in for charts.

accessibility.rules: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for text. All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button'). Ensure active/focus states are highly visible (ring-2).

media_and_images.instructions: Avatars for user profiles, abstract architectural for login hero area.

icons.instruction: Use lucide-react for all iconography. Keep stroke width to 1.5 or 2 for clarity.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Indonesian Enterprise KPI Dashboard. Ensure all text and labels are in Bahasa Indonesia (e.g., 'Beranda', 'Karyawan', 'Pengaturan', 'Keluar').
Add font imports for 'Work Sans' (Headings) and 'IBM Plex Sans' (Body) to public/index.html or src/index.css.
Follow the 'Flat / High Density' design rules: 1px borders, no shadows, very crisp tabular design.
Create a layout wrapper with a Sidebar (Sidebar contains Master Data, Input KPI, Rekap) and Topbar (User Profile, Logout).
Use Recharts for the Dashboard KPI trends (trend bulanan).
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and major sections have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-master-karyawan').
Do not use generic 'Vercel-like' styling (soft shadows, large rounded corners). Make it look like a serious data tool.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Keep data tables dense but use adequate padding (p-4 or p-6) for parent containers.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Never use placeholder image URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use provided image_urls.
All components must be functional in React (.js files in this setup, not .tsx).
